generation.structuredPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: preview concept for a full-screen desktop eye-break wallpaper
Primary request: a refined illustrated distant landscape for Unfocus, evolving the current ridgeline into a brighter, more natural workday break scene
Scene/backdrop: several smooth organic mountain and valley silhouettes receding into soft mist, one asymmetric focal summit left of center, distant open horizon, subtle atmospheric depth
Style/medium: premium matte editorial illustration with softly textured paper-like color fields and hairline contour details; elegant, minimal, contemporary
Composition/framing: 16:9 wide wallpaper; horizon in lower third; quiet low-detail center and sky for overlay copy; crop-safe for 16:10, 4:3, ultrawide, and portrait
Lighting/mood: calm cool daylight, restorative and awake, understated rather than whimsical
Color palette: deep evergreen foreground, cool sage and blue-gray distance, warm off-white haze
Constraints: static composition designed to lose a staring contest; no people, characters, animals, buildings, text, UI, logo, watermark, moon, stars, zigzag polygon mountains, glow effects, halos, full-width gradient bands, saturated colors, or busy micro-detail
Avoid: generic flat-vector style, childish illustration, fantasy spectacle, sharp geometric peaks, decorative clutter

derivative.description: 4K delivery derivative; the retained source is not native 4K
